content.short: Solrise Finance is built on Solana and enables users to create or invest in crypto funds.
content.description: Solrise Finance is a decentralized asset management and investment platform built on Solana. It enables anyone to invest in crypto assets organized into funds called Solrise funds, a model similar to hedge funds. These funds are managed by third-party managers whose track records are verifiable on the blockchain, providing a transparent basis for comparing performance and risk. Investors can choose funds that align with their risk appetite, gaining access to professional asset management within a decentralized framework.
